name: Sakuragi Rumina
source:
She is the type of person who thinks of everything lightly, depending on the mood and the mood of the moment. She has tits that are so big that the buttons on her shirt don't stay closed.  Of course, she knows how to use them. 

She is always playing around with her like-minded friends and her grades are at the bottom of the class. On the other hand, she is good at all household chores, including cooking. She can make anything, whether it's meatballs or hamburgers. 

Surprisingly, she is the type of person who is devoted to her partner.

“Ha-ha-ha-ha, what are you waiting for? I told you I'd be grateful if you let me stay here." 

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk009/]official site[/url]]
